offline.metric: raw unstandardized squared Euclidean error in saved 18-D DCT3 shape coefficients
offline.selection: minimum Dev v2 raw top-1 coefficient squared error over all 36 trained checkpoints; Eval not used
offline.selection_correction: candidate score uses that model key space; candidate selection and all reported coefficient errors use raw saved coefficient space
offline.target_rule: anchor_spans suffix to next boundary, extend to at least five actions
offline.inference_inputs: observed state/action history and (iii only) current VLM tokens; no target, task ID, or pi0.5 output

gripper_head.features: KC1 q-hidden + saved-coefficient retrieval scores/top-key + execution gripper state

calibration.reference_rule: T5 Dev v2 ehat>b fallback proportion; D_b uses inverted empirical CDF; T5 t0 radius formula

t0_calibration.reference_rule: T5 Dev v2 ehat>b fallback proportion; D_b uses inverted empirical CDF; T5 t0 radius formula

closed_loop.paired_protocol: same suite/task/trial index, seed_base=7, wait=10, replan=5, max 520

notes: offline_results.json は標準化あり/なしの設定比較で誤差空間が混ざったため、最終選択には使用していない。offline_corrected.json は全36チェックポイントを同じ生18次元係数二乗誤差で Dev v2 再評価して選び直した結果。
LIBERO-90 と LIBERO-10 は各100試行すべて complete。KC1サーバーログにOOMはない。
閉ループ試行中、一部のMuJoCo QACC不安定警告が端末に出たが、対応試行はstatus=completeで保存されている。
